# is-absolute-url [![Build Status](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/is-absolute-url.svg?branch=master)](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/is-absolute-url)

> Check if an URL is absolute


## Install

```sh
$ npm install --save is-absolute-url
```


## Usage

```js
var isAbsoluteUrl = require('is-absolute-url');

isAbsoluteUrl('http://example.invalid/foo/bar');
//=> true

isAbsoluteUrl('//example.invalid');
//=> false

isAbsoluteUrl('foo/bar');
//=> false
```


## Related

See [is-relative-url](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/is-relative-url) for the inverse.
